# Laguna Surf Lessons

> Private surf lessons at Thalia Street beach in Laguna Beach, California, taught by Troy MacDonald, a Laguna Beach native with over 20 years of surf instruction. Book online at https://surfinglagunabeach.com/#book or call 949-280-5818.

## Lessons and prices
- Private lesson: $160, 90 minutes, one-on-one with Troy.
- Private group: $130 per person, 2 to 5 people, only your own group in the water.
- Advanced coaching: $160, 90 minutes, for surfers who already stand up.
- Board, wetsuit and leash are included in every lesson.
- Add-ons: photo and video package $45, GoPro on the board $25.
- Gift cards: any amount from $50 to $1,000, emailed on the date you choose.

## Schedule
- Lessons start at 7:00, 9:00 and 11:00 AM all year, plus 1:00 and 3:00 PM from April to September.
- No lessons on Tuesdays. Book at least 12 hours ahead, up to 120 days out.

## Meeting point
- Thalia Street beach, Laguna Beach, CA 92651. Come down the Thalia Street stairs, turn left, and wait under the building overhang. Arrive 15 minutes early.
- Street parking on Thalia Street and Glenneyre Street.

## Good to know
- About 95% of Troy's students stand up in their first lesson.
- Ages: five and up for private lessons, seven and up for private groups, no upper age limit.
- You should be comfortable in water over your head.
- Cancellation: full refund with 24 hours' notice or if Troy cancels for conditions.
- Rated 4.8 out of 5 from 16 Google reviews.
